p: Introduce yourself and share what you want to build at Hanzo.

We are always looking for exceptional engineers, researchers, and builders who are passionate about open AI cloud infrastructure, compilers, cryptography, and autonomous agents. If you do not see a role that fits your background, apply here.

Hanzo builds an open AI cloud — compilers, models, distributed infrastructure, and agent tooling. Our codebases are predominantly open source, and team members operate with high autonomy and end-to-end ownership.
Propose, design, and lead projects within the Hanzo ecosystem.
Collaborate across engineering, research, and platform teams.
Contribute to open source codebases, benchmarks, and community architecture.
Strong technical foundation in software engineering, computer systems, or AI research.
History of independent problem solving and shipping real-world systems.
Curiosity, high agency, and clear technical communication.
